Description

Arranging to hire an excellent netball court at Riddlesdown Collegiate in Purley, Croydon is a straightforward process. The courts are maintained to a high standard, making them ideal for matches, team training, or a recreational game with friends. The courts are also floodlit, which allows for play in the evenings.

You can book a court on a pay-as-you-play basis, meaning you don't need a membership to secure your booking. You can check availability and book online through the Playfinder platform, which simplifies the process of finding and securing a time slot. Additionally, Riddlesdown Collegiate has free on-site parking available for visitors.
